PRIVATE: auditor and owner only; never given to the builder, the pipeline, or the automated judge

tiers.K: known-answer: documented failure with established mitigation; score key_elements coverage
tiers.D: debated/open: score feasibility, constraint fit, specificity, non-obviousness

scoring: per problem 0-4 on: question answered, key_elements covered (K) or quality checks met (D), commits to numbers with labelled assumptions, falsifier testable; plus red-flag penalties

key_elements: identifies Cr vapor transport to cathode TPB as the driver
names a conductive Cr-barrier spinel coating (Mn-Co spinel) or aluminizing/protective scale on the interconnect, or cathode-side Cr-getter
falsification via 10000 h stack test with post-test SEM/EDS of cathode Cr and polarization-resistance trend against the 5% target
red_flags: changes the interconnect alloy or cell footprint

key_elements: identifies moisture ingress at edges and UV-driven decomposition as co-drivers
names a low-WVTR edge seal (butyl/polyisobutylene) + UV-blocking encapsulant or front-sheet UV filter, and ion-blocking barrier to halt halide migration
falsification via IEC 61215 damp-heat + UV sequence with electroluminescence and output tracking against the 2% retention
red_flags: ignores UV or edge ingress separately

key_elements: identifies low pH/alkalinity and lack of corrosion inhibitor as the driver of lead solubility
names orthophosphate dosing to form insoluble lead-phosphate scale plus pH/alkalinity raise to reduce solubility, with a ramp to avoid scale destabilization
falsification via 12-month tap sampling (90th percentile <5 ppb) and pipe-loop scale characterization (XRD for lead-phosphate)
identifies salt/hydrocarbon aerosol deposition as the driver
names upgraded inlet coalescer/filtration (HEPA/electrostatic) plus optimized online water-wash cadence and detergent chemistry
falsification via heat-rate and compressor-efficiency trend before/after with borescope deposit scoring against the 3% recovery
identifies micro-slip fretting + oxidation at the contact interface as the driver
names interface treatment (tin/silver plating or contact lubricant) plus preload retention (Belleville/spring washer or prevailing-torque feature) to stop micro-slip
falsification via 1000 h vibration with 4-wire contact-resistance trend and post-test interface microscopy against the 10% drift
identifies biogenic sulfuric acid (Thiobacillus) on the crown as the driver, not the wastewater itself
names H2S control (ventilation, oxidant/iron-salt dosing, or antimicrobial) plus acid-resistant surface treatment or calcareous sacrificial aggregate
falsification via crown-loss coupons and H2S/acid-rate monitoring over 12 months against the 1 mm/yr limit
red_flags: treats wastewater-side only, ignoring crown headspace

key_elements: features from per-operation motor-current and vibro-acoustic signature (arc duration, contact-bounce, transition time) trended vs each unit's own baseline
persistence rule + relative threshold, not one fixed absolute value
retrospective validation against maintenance/teardown-confirmed contact erosion with lead-time and false-alarm reporting
cavitation-sensitive feature from existing signals (high-frequency vibration band / pressure pulsation / current signature) normalized to operating point (speed/flow)
persistence + relative-to-baseline threshold
validation against NPSH-margin tests and teardown erosion with lead-time/false-alarm reporting
power-curve residual (measured vs expected at same wind speed/air density) trended as the erosion proxy, plus acoustic/vibration confirmation
persistence + relative threshold vs each turbine's clean baseline
validation against drone/rope-access leading-edge inspection with lead-time/false-alarm reporting
overall heat-transfer coefficient U (or fouling resistance Rf) from existing T/P/flow, normalized to flow/viscosity, trended vs clean baseline
persistence + relative threshold
validation against cleaning records and duty trend with lead-time/false-alarm reporting
wheel-impact/load-detector trend and vibration feature per wheel, normalized to load/curvature, vs each wheel's baseline
persistence + relative threshold
validation against ultrasonic/visual tread inspection with lead-time/false-alarm reporting
torque-ripple / current-signature and encoder transmission-error feature per joint, normalized to load/speed, vs each joint's baseline
persistence + relative threshold
validation against backlash measurement and teardown with lead-time/false-alarm reporting
